goal_supervision: mean squared xyz error against mean available TRAIN reference endpoints
gradient_routing: route/set loss: full model; goal loss: goal head and shared observation encoders; clearance: route queries/blocks/output only, shared context and goal detached
initialization: same original12000 parent and seeded M8 expansion as B; independent goal decoder cloned from it; interior output rows divided by phi for comparable initial offsets; fresh AdamW
selection: fixed last3000; seed0 first then seed1/2 only with positive mechanism signal; no lambda sweep
q: unchanged Ordinary seed0 scorer, normalization, temperature, selector

round2.dual_update: projected lambda += eta*(rho-d), mean duplicate request draws within batch
round2.safe_gradient: zero outside violated constraints; safe signed slack lowers lambda
round2.state: request/query/segment table saved in each optimizer/RNG checkpoint; no inference state
